items.title: Kering Shares Surge 15% on Gucci's Turnaround Momentum
items.summary: Kering shares jumped as much as 16.9% in Paris trading, the stock's biggest daily move in decades, after Q2 group revenue of EUR3.65bn beat consensus and Gucci's comparable sales decline narrowed to 2% from 9% in Q1. Management cited early progress in brand desirability and cost control; H2 margins are expected to improve on H1's 12.8%.

items.title: Kering Shares Jump as Gucci Stabilises, Revenue Beats Forecasts
items.summary: UK financial press coverage of the Q2 print notes Western Europe remained a soft spot within group revenue even as Gucci's US leather-goods demand (Borsetto, Paparazzo bags) drove the improvement; CEO Luca de Meo reiterated 2026 full-year growth guidance while flagging a likely flat Q3 on tough comparisons.

items.title: HSBC Upgrades Kering to Buy, Raises Target to EUR340
items.summary: HSBC upgraded Kering from hold to buy and lifted its price target to EUR340 from EUR290 following the Q2 beat, joining a flurry of sell-side upgrades (including JPMorgan commentary) that credited Gucci's better-than-feared sales and de Meo's cost discipline for the improved outlook, while cautioning the turnaround is early-stage.

items.title: Gucci Racing Appoints Tancredi Vitale as Vice President
items.summary: Gucci named sports-industry veteran Tancredi Vitale (ex-Nike, Jordan, Adidas Y-3, Kappa, Venezia FC) as Vice President of Gucci Racing effective September 1, ahead of the brand's 2027 launch as title partner of the Alpine Formula One team -- part of Kering's push to build a new sportswear/experiential platform around Gucci.

items.title: Gucci Racing annuncia il suo vicepresidente in vista dello sbarco in F1
items.summary: Italian sports-trade coverage of the Vitale appointment frames Gucci's Formula 1 entry as a calculated bet by Kering to reach younger, sport-engaged consumers in Europe; purely descriptive of the appointment and Kering's motorsport ambitions, no independent evaluative commentary from the outlet.

items.title: TikTok discovery page aggregates ongoing "Gucci Demna" content wave
items.summary: TikTok's dedicated discovery/hashtag page for Gucci-Demna content shows continued high posting volume weeks after the runway debut, mixing fan edits, styling try-ons of the new leather goods and skeptical commentary questioning whether the Tom-Ford-referencing aesthetic is derivative rather than a fresh direction.

items.title: Gucci: en passe d'amorcer son retournement?
items.summary: French trade analysis of the Q2 results is cautiously framed: Gucci's H1 2026 revenue of EUR2.757bn is down 9% reported, and the piece recalls Gucci lost more than EUR4.5bn in revenue between 2022 and 2025, arguing sequential improvement is not yet proof of a durable recovery given continued European softness.

items.title: Sbagliare ora il rapporto prezzo/posizionamento sarebbe tragico
items.summary: Italian leather-goods trade press critiques Gucci and peers for pushing prices into a positioning no-man's-land between premium and true luxury; cites Brunello Cucinelli-adjacent commentary that recent price increases were not matched by real gains in product value, warning that getting price/positioning wrong now (mid-turnaround) would be a serious strategic mistake.
